svg.text: DYNAMIC TEMPLATE • MOVING ARROWS & LIVE PACKETS
Naive Agent Loop vs. Production Loop: The Lines That Stop Runaway Retries and Fake Completions
Same task, same model, same tools — only the harness code differs. The same guards exist as ADK RunConfig, LangGraph recursion_limit, CrewAI max_iter, and OpenHands max_iterations.
BEFORE — naive loop (what most teams ship, on any framework)
while True: # no step or cost ceiling
result = tools.call(action) # same failing call, forever
if "DONE" in result.text: # the LLM decides it is done
# Same bug whether the loop is hand-written,
# with max_iter left at its default.
AFTER — guarded production loop (Google Cloud ADK or open-source equivalents)
for step in range(max_steps): # hard step ceiling
if spent > max_usd: # Billing budget / LiteLLM
Curated by Nitin Aggarwal • Google Cloud ADK + OpenHands Factory • Proprietary + Confidential
Sources: IDEA-01 loop breaker • IDEA-03 verify hook • IDEA-06 checkpoints • LangGraph / CrewAI / OpenHands docs
